discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its development into therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has had enormous clinical impact through semaglutide and related drugs. It has already won the Lasker (2024), the Breakthrough Prize and the Gairdner, and recent prizes (mRNA 2023, microRNA 2024, Tregs 2025) leave metabolic and endocrine medicine due for recognition. Habener, Mojsov and Knudsen are the most-cited trio for the discovery of the peptide's insulinotropic form and the development of long-acting analogues.
